dispatchLogs.message: Waypoint Delhi, India Fix (28.66°, 77.29°) added to Expedition exp-702.
MAYDAY ACKNOWLEDGED by Operations Desk Lead. SAR asset SKIBIRD-91 (Skibird LC-130H Hercules (Tail 091)) dispatched.

*** MAYDAY DISTRESS BEACON ACTIVE *** [Crevasse Fall / Structural Ice Breach] Snowcat lead track broke through concealed snow bridge into 25m slot void. Vehicle anchored, personnel secured in bivouac. (Urgency: Stage-2 Hypothermia / Immediate Evacuation, Souls: 4) (-85.25, 151.10) [Source: Mobile Phone Field Unit]
Traverse convoy PB-Alpha and Quad-01 safely cleared waypoint 4 climb. Both engines running nominal. Fuel consumption 415L/24h.
Radar scan identified 4.2m subsurface void 120m bearing 195°. Convoy diverted 400m east onto solid firn.
Condition 2 declared for Southern Ross Sector. Gale warning 45 knots with drifting snow. Aircraft flights on hold.
Completed core transect 3. Bedrock thermal probe reading -2.1°C at base of ice column. Commencing return leg staging.
Clean skiway drag finished. Surface temp -51°C, wind 14 knots from 040. Prepared for scheduled Otter resupply.

completedWorkLogs.title: Generator Fuel Line Thermal Trace Activation & Cleared Rail Pressure Warning
completedWorkLogs.actionTaken: Activated secondary trace heater blanket, balanced rail pressure from 1.8 to 3.8 bar, cleared technician ticket from active queue.
completedWorkLogs.resolutionNotes: Paraffin wax micro-crystals dissolved from micron pre-filter mesh. System rail pressure stabilized at nominal 3.8 bar.
completedWorkLogs.avertedImpactOrSavings: Averted base blackout, saved $14,000 in emergency generator overhaul.

completedWorkLogs.title: Snowcat Tractor Belt Inspection & Pre-Failure Replacement
completedWorkLogs.actionTaken: Confirmed HNBR serpentine belt replacement with 8.2mm tension, verified cold-soak elasticity, cleared maintenance task.
completedWorkLogs.resolutionNotes: Pre-failure replacement completed prior to traverse. Belt vitrification stress test passed down to -50°C.

completedWorkLogs.title: Convoy PBD-04 Tactical Sastrugi Reroute & Hazard Clearing

completedWorkLogs.resolutionNotes: Active route safely routed 800m north of dangerous transverse fissure field. Convoy completed passage without incident.

completedWorkLogs.resolutionNotes: Depot reserves topped up to 14,200L before katabatic storm closure. Temperature dropped to -44°C safely.
